title: Finite relation maps have finite support over quasi-compact basis opens
statement: Let $X$ be a topological space and $\mathcal B$ a basis of its topology whose members are quasi-compact. Let $A,B$ be sets, let $U_a\in\mathcal B$ ($a\in A$) and $V_b\in\mathcal B$ ($b\in B$), and let $S_a,T_b$ be finite sets; $j_{U!}\underline S$ denotes the extension by the empty set [def-weil-pbc-sets-extension-by-empty] of the sheaf $\underline S_U$ of locally constant maps to $S$ on $U$. Coproducts are coproducts in the category of sheaves of sets on $X$ [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]; for subsets $A'\subseteq A$, $B'\subseteq B$ let $\kappa_{A'}:\coprod_{a\in A'}j_{U_a!}\underline{S_a}\to\coprod_{a\in A}j_{U_a!}\underline{S_a}$ and $\lambda_{B'}:\coprod_{b\in B'}j_{V_b!}\underline{T_b}\to\coprod_{b\in B}j_{V_b!}\underline{T_b}$ be the morphisms induced by the coprojections. Then for every morphism $h:\coprod_{b\in B}j_{V_b!}\underline{T_b}\to\coprod_{a\in A}j_{U_a!}\underline{S_a}$ of sheaves of sets and every finite subset $B'\subseteq B$ there are a finite subset $A'\subseteq A$ and a morphism $g:\coprod_{b\in B'}j_{V_b!}\underline{T_b}\to\coprod_{a\in A'}j_{U_a!}\underline{S_a}$ with $\kappa_{A'}\circ g=h\circ\lambda_{B'}$ (the restriction of $h$ to the finite subcoproduct over $B'$ factors through the finite subcoproduct over $A'$). In particular, for two such morphisms $h_1,h_2$ and finite $B'$ one finite $A'$ serves both (take the union of the two subsets, using $\kappa_{A''}\circ\kappa_{A''A'}=\kappa_{A'}$ for $A'\subseteq A''$).

source.place: Modules, Lemma Tag 0CAI (lemma-filtered-colimit-constructibles), proof at lines 3047-3058: finite subsets of B have finite supports in A because sections over quasi-compact V_b commute with the directed coproduct

proof.text: *Step 1 (the target coproduct as a directed colimit).* Write $C_{A'}=\coprod_{a\in A'}j_{U_a!}\underline{S_a}$ for $A'\subseteq A$, with coprojections $\iota^{A'}_a$, $C=C_A$, $\kappa_{A''A'}:C_{A'}\to C_{A''}$ ($A'\subseteq A''$) the morphism with $\kappa_{A''A'}\iota^{A'}_a=\iota^{A''}_a$, and $\kappa_{A'}=\kappa_{AA'}$. By [lem-weil-pbc-sheaf-coproduct-finite-subcoproducts] (1), $(C,(\kappa_{A'})_{A'})$ is the colimit in sheaves of sets of the system $(C_{A'},\kappa_{A''A'})$ indexed by the directed set of finite subsets $A'\subseteq A$ (ordered by inclusion), and by (2) of that lemma every transition map $\kappa_{A''A',W}$ is injective on sections over every open $W$. Moreover $\kappa_{A''}\kappa_{A''A'}=\kappa_{A'}$, since both sides agree after composing with every coprojection $\iota^{A'}_a$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit].

source.place: Modules, proof of Lemma Tag 0CAI (lemma-filtered-colimit-constructibles), lines 3048-3055: 'we can view the right hand side as a filtered colimit with injective transition maps'

proof.text: *Step 2 (sections over a basis open come from a finite subcoproduct).* Let $V\in\mathcal B$; it is quasi-compact by hypothesis. Applying [lem-weil-pbc-sheaves-injective-directed-colimit-qc-sections] (2) to the system of Step 1 (directed, with injective transition maps, colimit $(C,(\kappa_{A'}))$) and the quasi-compact open $V$: every $t\in C(V)$ is of the form $\kappa_{A',V}(s)$ for some finite $A'\subseteq A$ and some $s\in C_{A'}(V)$.

source.place: Modules, proof of Lemma Tag 0CAI (lemma-filtered-colimit-constructibles), lines 3048-3055: 'Hence taking sections over the quasi-compact opens $V_b$, $b\in B'$ commutes with this coproduct' (Sheaves, Lemma Tag 009F, part (3), sheaves.tex line 3444)

proof.text: *Step 3 (a map out of $j_{V!}\underline T$ is a map of sets $T\to\mathcal G(V)$).* Let $V\subseteq X$ be open, $T$ a set and $\theta:j_{V,p!}\underline T_V\to j_{V!}\underline T$ the sheafification map [def-weil-pbc-sets-extension-by-empty]; for $t\in T$ the constant map $\mathrm{const}_t\in\underline T_V(V)=(j_{V,p!}\underline T_V)(V)$ (as $V\subseteq V$). For a sheaf of sets $\mathcal G$ on $X$ define $\beta_{\mathcal G}:\operatorname{Hom}(j_{V!}\underline T,\mathcal G)\to\operatorname{Map}(T,\mathcal G(V))$, $\psi\mapsto(t\mapsto\psi_V(\theta_V(\mathrm{const}_t)))$. It is the composite of the bijection $\psi\mapsto(\psi\circ\theta)|_V$ of [lem-weil-pbc-sets-extension-by-empty-adjunction] (2) onto $\operatorname{Hom}_{\Sh(V)}(\underline T_V,\mathcal G|_V)$ with the bijection $\varphi\mapsto(t\mapsto\varphi_V(\mathrm{const}_t))$ of [lem-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf-open-maps-sections] for the sheaf $\mathcal G|_V$ on $V$ (whose value on $V$ is $\mathcal G(V)$); so $\beta_{\mathcal G}$ is bijective. It is natural: for $\alpha:\mathcal G\to\mathcal G'$, $\beta_{\mathcal G'}(\alpha\circ\psi)=\alpha_V\circ\beta_{\mathcal G}(\psi)$, directly from the formula ($(\alpha\circ\psi)_V=\alpha_V\circ\psi_V$).

source.place: Sheaves, Lemma Tag 00A3 (lemma-j-shriek, line 4549) (2), as used in Modules, proof of Lemma Tag 0CAH (lemma-surjection): a section over U corresponds to a map j_{U!}S -> F; with Sites, Example Tag 0H7J (example-constant-sheaf)

proof.text: *Step 4 (lifting each summand over $B'$).* Let $B'\subseteq B$ be finite. For $b\in B'$ let $\varepsilon_b$ be the coprojection of $j_{V_b!}\underline{T_b}$ into $\coprod_{b\in B}j_{V_b!}\underline{T_b}$, $\psi_b=h\circ\varepsilon_b:j_{V_b!}\underline{T_b}\to C$, and $\tau_b=\beta_C(\psi_b):T_b\to C(V_b)$ (Step 3). For each $b\in B'$ and $t\in T_b$, Step 2 (with $V=V_b\in\mathcal B$) gives a finite $A_{b,t}\subseteq A$ and $s_{b,t}\in C_{A_{b,t}}(V_b)$ with $\tau_b(t)=\kappa_{A_{b,t},V_b}(s_{b,t})$. Put $A'=\bigcup_{b\in B',t\in T_b}A_{b,t}$, a finite union of finite sets (as $B'$ and all $T_b$ are finite), so $A'$ is finite. Define $\tau'_b:T_b\to C_{A'}(V_b)$ by $\tau'_b(t)=\kappa_{A'A_{b,t},V_b}(s_{b,t})$; by Step 1, $\kappa_{A',V_b}\circ\tau'_b=\tau_b$. Let $\psi'_b=\beta_{C_{A'}}^{-1}(\tau'_b):j_{V_b!}\underline{T_b}\to C_{A'}$ (Step 3). By naturality, $\beta_C(\kappa_{A'}\circ\psi'_b)=\kappa_{A',V_b}\circ\tau'_b=\tau_b=\beta_C(\psi_b)$, and $\beta_C$ is injective, so $\kappa_{A'}\circ\psi'_b=\psi_b=h\circ\varepsilon_b$.

source.place: Modules, proof of Lemma Tag 0CAI (lemma-filtered-colimit-constructibles), lines 3048-3055: 'For every finite subset $B'\subset B$ there is a finite subset $A'\subset A$ such that the coproduct over $b\in B'$ maps into the coproduct over $a\in A'$'

proof.text: *Step 5 (assembling).* Let $\varepsilon^{B'}_b$ ($b\in B'$) be the coprojections of $\coprod_{b\in B'}j_{V_b!}\underline{T_b}$, so $\lambda_{B'}\varepsilon^{B'}_b=\varepsilon_b$, and let $g:\coprod_{b\in B'}j_{V_b!}\underline{T_b}\to C_{A'}$ be the morphism with $g\varepsilon^{B'}_b=\psi'_b$ (universal property of the coproduct [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]). Then $\kappa_{A'}g\varepsilon^{B'}_b=\kappa_{A'}\psi'_b=h\varepsilon_b=h\lambda_{B'}\varepsilon^{B'}_b$ for all $b\in B'$ (Step 4), hence $\kappa_{A'}\circ g=h\circ\lambda_{B'}$ by the uniqueness in the universal property. For two morphisms $h_1,h_2$ with finite subsets $A'_1,A'_2$ and maps $g_1,g_2$, $A''=A'_1\cup A'_2$ is finite and $\kappa_{A''A'_k}\circ g_k$ ($k=1,2$) are factorizations through $C_{A''}$, since $\kappa_{A''}\kappa_{A''A'_k}=\kappa_{A'_k}$ (Step 1).
